description: smelter/messages.json: the words of the Smelter's refusals, and of the messages it logs that a reader relies on.

refusals.description: Each refusal of an operation, on the operation's failure channel.

operation.description: The operation it refuses: a request of bus/registry.json's operations that the Smelter answers.

situation.description: When it is written, and what fills each `{name}` of its text.

message.description: The failure's `message`. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

logged.description: Each message the Smelter logs that a reader of its output relies on.

situation.description: When it is written, what fills each `{name}` of its fields, and what each fact it carries says.

message.description: The line's message, word for word.

fields.description: The facts the line is logged with whose form is stated, by name: each a text whose `{name}` is filled as the row's `situation` says. A fact that is a number is its decimal digits.

additionalProperties.description: The fact's value. A `{name}` in it is filled with what the row's `situation` names, and nothing else in it varies.

carries.description: The facts the line is logged with beside `fields`, whose value the row's `situation` says and whose form is not stated. The line may carry others.
